name: Carcin AI Visibility Toolkit
author: adaptmarketing

sections.description:
Carcin AI Visibility Toolkit makes your WordPress site readable and cite-worthy for AI answer engines. Traditional SEO targets Google’s blue links; this toolkit targets the AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Apple Intelligence — that read your content and quote it in chat answers.

Every feature is free, fully functional, and runs entirely on your own server. The plugin makes zero outbound network calls.

What it does

  1. Publishes a machine-readable index of your site at /llms.txt (and the full content at /llms-full.txt) following the llmstxt.org convention.
  2. Manages AI crawler access in your robots.txt for 23 known AI bots — one-click allow / disallow per vendor, no file editing.
  3. Injects clean schema.org JSON-LD so AI engines understand each page (Article, WebPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebSite with SearchAction). Per-post type overrides via post meta.
  4. Serves per-page markdown — append .md to any URL (/about/ → /about.md) for a theme-stripped markdown rendering. AI crawlers prefer pre-cleaned content.
  5. Logs every AI bot visit to your site — bot, path, status, last seen, top crawled paths. Retention configurable up to 365 days.

Features

  • /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt auto-generation, regenerated on every post save
  • AI crawler manager for 23 bots: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, meta-externalfetcher, Bytespider, CCBot, cohere-ai, MistralAI-User, YouBot, DuckAssistBot, Amazonbot, Diffbot, omgili, Timpibot
  • Schema.org JSON-LD: Article, WebPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebSite (with SearchAction)
  • Per-post schema overrides via the _carcin_aivt_schema_type and _carcin_aivt_schema_extra meta keys
  • Per-page markdown endpoint at /<path>.md
  • Crawler log with bot, path, status, and last-seen timestamp; retention 1–365 days
  • Yoast / RankMath / All in One SEO compatibility — respects existing noindex flags, coexists with their schema output (or defer entirely via the carcin_aivt_defer_to_seo_plugin filter)
  • Zero outbound network calls — the plugin runs entirely on your server

Who builds this

Ad-Apt — a Portland, OR performance marketing agency. We built the toolkit because our clients needed it, and we use it ourselves on every site we ship.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New → search for “Carcin AI Visibility Toolkit”.
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to AI Visibility in the WP admin sidebar.
  4. Verify /llms.txt and /robots.txt look right (linked from the Overview tab).
sections.faq:
What is AI visibility / Answer Engine Optimization?

It’s the practice of structuring your site so AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini can read it cleanly and cite it as a source in their answers. The same way classic SEO helps Google understand your site, this toolkit helps AI engines understand it.

Does this guarantee my content gets cited by ChatGPT?

No plugin can. This toolkit gives AI crawlers the cleanest possible read of your content (the same way a sitemap helps Google but doesn’t guarantee ranking). The rest is content quality, authority, and freshness — same fundamentals as classic SEO.

Will this conflict with Yoast, RankMath, or All in One SEO?

No. The toolkit respects their noindex flags and emits a separate JSON-LD graph. If you’d rather use only their schema, disable our JSON-LD output from the Schema tab, or apply the carcin_aivt_defer_to_seo_plugin filter. The rest of the toolkit (llms.txt, robots manager, markdown endpoint, crawler log) keeps working alongside any SEO plugin.

What is llms.txt?

A proposed convention (see llmstxt.org) for giving AI crawlers a clean, structured index of your site at the root path /llms.txt. Some AI vendors already prefer it over crawling theme HTML. The toolkit auto-generates it for every public page on save.

Does the plugin send any data anywhere?

No. The plugin makes zero outbound network requests. Everything runs on your server.

Where is data stored?

Settings live in a single options row (carcin_aivt_settings). Crawler hit logs live in a custom table ({$wpdb->prefix}carcin_aivt_crawler_log). Both are dropped on uninstall.

Is the source open?

Yes — GPLv2-or-later, distributed via WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Align the text domain with the assigned plugin slug (carcin-ai-visibility-toolkit) per wp.org review.
  • Tested against WordPress 7.1.

1.0.2

  • Emit JSON-LD via wp_print_inline_script_tag() instead of a raw echo (wp.org review feedback).

1.0.1

  • Align text domain with the plugin slug (aeo-toolkit).
  • Escape late on the markdown and llms.txt endpoints (wp_kses_post on output body).
  • Harden JSON-LD output (HEX_TAG/HEX_AMP/HEX_APOS/HEX_QUOT) to prevent any </script> injection through schema data.

1.0.0

  • First release under the Carcin AI Visibility Toolkit name. All features are free and fully functional; no account, license, or remote service is required.
